profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer • Android • Apps
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with enthusiasm for all things tech. Interested in new technologies, processes and tools to aid in development. With a belief in constantly looking for ways to improve software; be it the development process, the user interface, or the software's architecture. Experienced developing Android mobile apps--delivering software products used by millions of users to market. Solutions that are maintainable, scalable, and UI rich with compelling interactions and quality.

Specialties: 
* Android development
* Java, Kotlin, Shell scripting
* Mobile applications
* Application Architecture 
* Model-View-X Architectures (MVP, MVI, MVVM)
* User interface (UI)/Front-end programming
* Agile software development methodology
* Analytics, A/B Testing, Crash Reporting
* SQLite, JSON, REST
* Android Studio, Android Jetpack, Git, Wiki markup

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developer on Kasa for Android smart home app--responsible for developing and architecting features; collaborating with cross-functional teams to reach product goals; and providing technical direction and knowledge regarding the Kasa app and Android platform.

● Core developer on lighting effects feature for the light strip product line. Worked closely with firmware and cloud teams to help define API usage and data structures. Worked with UX and product to refine requirements for scalability and technical limitations. Implemented the majority of the UI screens; logic to store/cache, play effects; and effect customization.

● Developed UI for controlling Smart Light Bulb devices-- created complex custom rich UI views to pick/control brightness, color hue, saturation, and color temperature. Used Android canvas and drawing layers for custom UI; and optimized performance by rate limiting api calls to ensure smoother responsive interaction with bulb device.

● Introduced and integrated the MVP pattern and dependency injection architecture patterns and concepts to app and team to improve codebase maintainability. The additions resulted in better separation from business and UI logic to help support future changes.

● Lead the initiative in adopting the Kotlin programming language. Investigated feasibility in migrating over to Kotlin; researched and documented best practices; and took an existing feature written in Java and went through the process of rewriting in Kotlin.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developer on the Android team responsible for enhancing and maintaining the native Guidebook Android application. Implemented new features and improving the app's quality and stability. 

●  Implemented entire audio tours feature – utilized Google Maps API to render map paths and trigger location 
based information, created an Android Service to control and play tour audio through the MediaPlayer API,  
and used OkHttp library for downloading media files  
●  Integrated application wide analytics and event tracking leveraging third-party service and library.  Adding 
new tracking events as features are built to help provide metrics and insights to app usage. 
●  Collaborated with data scientist to investigate and integrate an AB testing framework. Used in conjunction 
with analytics to track, control, and create experiments for user experiences to aid in business decisions. 
●  Created a refreshed app onboarding experience with design, making heavy usage of Android animation 
framework to create effects enhancing and promoting the signup experience. 
●  Improved sqlite database usage by implementing migration logic, debugging reported Crashlytics issues, and 
researching Android best practices to sqlite database access. 
●  Refreshed the user interface on several of the app’s views, including the login/sign up, splash, and 
homescreen.  Created custom views and leveraging framework widgets to build a better user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer for the Clients and Mobility Business Unit (CMBU) under the Mobility team.
  Worked on Cisco Jabber for Android enterprise mobile unified communications client (voice ,video,   and instant message) on the Android platform

● Implemented and maintained features by leveraging Android SDK, NDK, open 
source libraries, and internal company libraries. 

● Analyzed root causes and fixes for reported issues and defects by utilizing application logs, Android logcat, SIP traces, Wireshark traces, and internal Cisco debugging tools.  Provided detailed explanation and documentation for every fix and issue found.

● Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams (UE design, QA engineers, Product managers) in developing user interface and functionality for features to ensure quality and specifications are met.

● Implemented and refactored application UI; developed and refactored telephony in call views utilizing Android’s view widgets, layouts and fragments; developed UI and dragging logic for camera self-preview video features; contributions ensured a modular and maintainable codebase that was scalable to a variety of devices and dimensions.

positions.title: Student Programmer
positions.description:
A student programmer at the Computer Science Instructional Facility (CSIF) for the university's Computer Science department.
  
● Provided IT support for the computer lab, maintaining the hardware and software for the facility. 
● Troubleshot users' computer problems with applications, OS, and/or user accounts.  
● Assisted the systems administrator in repairing and monitoring the equipment of the facility.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Software Intern in the Gigabit Switching Business Unit (GSBU) under the Devtest Automation team.

- Worked on automated testbed configurations, executions, and scripting.  
- Developed a template for testbed (device topologies) configuration files.  
- Executed testbed configurations

projects.title: Cisco Jabber for Android
projects.description: Place, receive, and manage calls over a Wi-Fi network using your Android mobile device and the Cisco Jabber for Android application. Use video, voice, IM, voicemail, and escalation into meetings to make decisions fast and accurately. Run Jabber in the background to receive calls and instant messages but not interfere with other applications on your device.

projects.title: Guidebook
projects.description:
Guidebook is your guide to events, conferences, campuses, and more. Download the app to:

[+] Build your personal schedule and to-do lists.
[+] Easily access speaker, sponsor, exhibitor information, and more.
[+] View maps of the venue and local area.
[+] Simply search for information within the app.
[+] Connect and engage with other attendees through private messages.
[+] Share photos, likes, and comments on the interactive social feed.
